summary: Treats multiple input CHOPs as keyframes, sorts them in time, and interpolates between them to fill gaps.
key_concepts: Treats multiple input CHOPs as keyframes and interpolates between them to fill gaps.
Inputs are sorted in time without shifting them, so source timing remains planner-critical.
The output channel count follows the first input.
When Match is Channel Name, missing channels in an input are treated as no keyframe for that channel.
Shape chooses the interpolation curve and Overlap Priority resolves overlapping multi-frame inputs.

key_params.name: blendfunc
key_params.note: Interpolation shape such as linear, ease, cubic, add, or hold previous

key_params.name: overlap
key_params.note: How overlapping multi-frame inputs are resolved

key_params.name: match
key_params.note: Match channels by index or name

common_gotchas: Inputs are sorted in time without shifting them.
The output channel count follows the first input.
When matching by name, a missing channel in an input is treated as no keyframe for that channel.
Single-frame inputs such as Constant CHOPs are the common keyframe source.
Overlap handling only matters when inputs have multi-frame intervals that overlap.
